brand.name: Sofar Solar
brand.notes: Chinese OEM with an official Pakistan footprint; SOFAR's own newsroom and brochure both list Pakistan as a market, and Omega Power Technologies is a confirmed SOFAR distribution partner in Pakistan (the stronger 'master distributor' claim rested on sofar.pk, now dead - see NEGATIVE 13). Max Power (this KB's max-power brand) is a separate PK importer that RESELLS the Sofar series alongside its own Voltas/Suntronic lines, so no max-power entries were created here.

series.name: HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH (three-phase hybrid 5-20 kW, PV + battery + EPS)
ME 5K...20KTL-3PH (AC-coupled storage 5-20 kW, no PV input)
HYD 3-6K-EP (single-phase hybrid 3-6 kW, PV + battery + EPS + generator)
ESI 3-6K-S1 (stacked single-phase hybrid 3-6 kW, PV + BTS 5K battery + EPS)
